title: The Silence on the Desolate Rooftop — Part 1

series.summary: Following Hisashi's tragic death on the school rooftop, Rei collapses in overwhelming grief beside his corpse. Takashi refuses to let her give up, forcing her to choose between surrendering to death or fighting for survival. Choosing to live, Rei attempts to contact her father, a senior police detective, for rescue. But with telecommunication networks completely severed and no emergency sirens sounding across the city, the two students realize civilization is paralyzed and they are entirely on their own.

segments.voiceover_text: On the rooftop, Rei is shattered by Hisashi's death. She stares at the bloodstained bat, praying that this living nightmare is just a cruel dream.
Takashi grabs her shoulders, forcing her to confront reality. He demands to know whether she wants to lie down and die right here.
Rei wipes away her tears. Looking Takashi directly in the eye, she resolves that she refuses to die today.
Rei frantically dials her father, a senior police officer. But every cellular network is dead, and the silence below proves no help is coming.
